post.summary:
Creates an HO custom service (RAP-38 Story 2.5). The service is owned by the caller's report
group and is NOT pushed to any pharmacy — it lands in the catalogue as "Not pushed". Returns
the created service. Pushing to pharmacies is a separate operation (Story 2.7).

put.summary:
Edits an HO-owned service (RAP-38 Story 2.5). The change updates the shared service definition, so
it applies to every pharmacy already linked to it — this does not push to new pharmacies. Returns
the updated service.

Extends or shortens the auto-activation deadline on a pending push (RAP-38 Story 3a.5, AC1a).
Shortening into the past is allowed — the nightly job picks it up on its next run.

post.summary:
Pushes an HO service to pharmacies in the group (RAP-38 Story 2.7) by scope — all, by state, or
selected pharmacies. Force-links each target with visibility off (pushed, not yet live). Returns
the push result with updated counts.
Mark multiple messages as Ready to collect

Forward log from Pharmacy-Web client (angular application) to CloudWatch.
Callers should use a bearer token if they have one, despite AllowAnonymous, to allow the caller identity to be included in the log entry.

get.summary:
Get full pending order with line items and resolved statuses (Epic 2 — Story 2.1).
Returns HTTP 404 when the order does not exist or does not belong to this pharmacy.

delete.summary:
Delete a pending order (Epic 2 — Story 2.5a, FR29).
Returns 404 when the order does not exist or does not belong to this pharmacy.

get.summary:
Get a completed order with read-only details and PIA payment status (Epic 6 — Story 6.1).
Returns HTTP 404 when the order does not exist or does not belong to this pharmacy.

Get full eScript token detail for a line item (Epic 3 — Story 3.2, FR15).
Returns 404 when the order does not belong to this pharmacy or the token is not found.

put.summary:
Update delivery address fields, shipping method, or delivery status (Story 4.1 — FR18–FR20).
Returns 404 when the order does not exist, does not belong to this pharmacy, or is not a delivery order.

post.summary:
Add or update a pharmacy note on an order (Epic 5 — Story 5.1, FR24).
Returns 404 when the order does not belong to this pharmacy.

Finalise (complete) a pending order (Story 2.5b — FR27).
Returns 404 when the order does not exist or does not belong to this pharmacy.
Returns 400 when the order has no line items to tally.

Send an eScript token to the dispensing system (Epic 3 — Story 3.3, FR16).
Always returns HTTP 200; the response body Code field indicates SUCCESS,
FALLBACK_TO_PLUSONE (Angular must call PlusOne JS bridge), or ERROR.
Returns 404 when the order does not belong to this pharmacy.

Add a custom line item to a pending order (Story 3.5 — FR13).
Returns the full updated order so the caller can refresh its list in one round-trip.
Returns 400 when the name is missing; 404 when the order does not belong to this pharmacy.

Update the status of a line item (Epic 3 — Story 3.1, FR6–FR9).
Returns 404 when the order or component does not belong to this pharmacy.
Returns 400 when action = OnOrder but followUpDate is absent.

Refund the PIA charge for a completed order (Epic 6 — Story 6.4, CRO-5).
Returns 404 when the order does not exist or does not belong to this pharmacy.
Returns 400 with an error message when the refund is rejected (gateway failure,
disbursed, already refunded, delay window, etc.).

Send a reminder message to a patient for a completed order (Epic 6 — Story 6.2, CRO-2).
Returns 404 when the order does not exist or does not belong to this pharmacy.
Returns 400 when the message body is missing or empty.

Return all items for a completed order to stock (Epic 6 — Story 6.3, CRO-3).
Returns 404 when the order does not exist or does not belong to this pharmacy.

delete.summary:
Delete a custom line item from a pending order (Story 3.5 — FR14).
Returns 404 when the order, item, or pharmacy context is not found, or the item
is not a custom item (only custom items may be deleted via this endpoint).

MedAdvisor.PharmacyUnifiedAPI.v1.Models..description:
Payload to create a head-office custom service (RAP-38 Story 2.5). The created capability is
owned by the caller's report group (OwnerReportGroup_ID) and has NO pharmacy links yet — it
lands in the catalogue as "Not pushed" until a separate push creates the link rows.
            
Deferred from the wireframe at v1: the fixed pre-screener (Medicare + DOB) and the consent
declaration. Category is also omitted — it has no storage target yet (OQ-02: the category value
set is unsettled / expected to come from KAMS metadata), so it is not accepted here rather than
invent a column or XML element that may conflict with the eventual design.

name.description: Service name. Required. Stored on PharmacyCapability.Name (max 50 chars).

duration.description: Default duration in minutes. Stored in DescriptionElements ("dur").

fee.description: Optional fee in dollars. Stored in DescriptionElements ("fee").

description.description: Optional website/booking description. Stored in DescriptionElements ("ext" blurb).

MedAdvisor.PharmacyUnifiedAPI.v1.Models..description:
Payload to edit an existing HO-owned service (RAP-38 Story 2.5). Same fields as create. The edit
updates the single shared PharmacyCapability, so it applies to every pharmacy currently linked to
the service — there is no per-pharmacy copy to re-push.
            
Deferred at v1, same as create: the fixed pre-screener (Medicare + DOB), the consent declaration,
and Category (no storage target yet).

name.description: Service name. Required. Stored on PharmacyCapability.Name (max 50 chars).

duration.description: Default duration in minutes. Stored in DescriptionElements ("dur").

fee.description: Optional fee in dollars. Stored in DescriptionElements ("fee").

description.description: Optional website/booking description. Stored in DescriptionElements ("ext" blurb).

MedAdvisor.PharmacyUnifiedAPI.v1.Models..description:
Extends or shortens the auto-activation deadline on an already-pushed, still-pending service
(RAP-38 Story 3a.5, AC1a). Date-only. A past date is allowed — the nightly job picks it up on its
next run.

Push an HO service to pharmacies in the group (RAP-38 Story 2.7). Targets are always resolved
within the caller's group. Scope is "all", "states", or "pharmacies".
            
MVP behaviour: pushing force-links the service to each target pharmacy with visibility OFF — the
pharmacy has the service but it is not active/bookable until turned on. Pharmacy-side activation
(notification + opt-in in MFP) is a later piece.

pharmacyIds.description: Pharmacy IDs when Scope = "pharmacies" (intersected with group membership).

MedAdvisor.PharmacyUnifiedAPI.v1.Models..description: Need to provie an orderId, an order description and recall URL is valid.

Order payload returned by GET /api/v1/RefillOrder/PendingOrder/{orderId} and
GET /api/v1/RefillOrder/CompletedOrder/{orderId}.
Used by the Angular Pending Order and Completed Order dialogs (RAP-6).

patientId.description:
MedAdvisor user ID of the order owner.
Null for guest orders (no registered patient profile).
Required by FR37 (patient header navigation) and FR38 (caree navigation).

patientName.description: Full formatted name: title + first name + last name.

phone.description:
Patient's mobile number.
Populated for both guest and registered-patient orders.
Only used by the Completed Order dialog (Story 6.1); null when not available.

guestEmail.description: Email on file for the guest. Null for registered-patient orders.

guestMobile.description: Mobile number for the guest. Null for registered-patient orders.

isSmsGuestCommunicationPreference.description: Guest prefers to be contacted by SMS.

isEmailGuestCommunicationPreference.description: Guest prefers to be contacted by email.

hasEScript.description: At least one line item has an associated eScript token.

piaChargeAmount.description:
Amount of the PIA charge. Null when no charge was attempted.
Source: RefillOrderPaymentStatus.TotalCost.

piaChargeStatus.description:
"Success" when the charge was captured (Status==1) or refunded (Status==3).
"Failed" when the charge was attempted but did not succeed.
Null when IsPayInAdvance is false or no charge record exists.

isRefunded.description:
True when the PIA charge has been refunded or is no longer refundable
(disbursed, awaiting disbursement, or a previous refund attempt failed).
When true the Refund button is hidden even if PiaChargeStatus is "Success".

piaCardAccount.description: Masked card number e.g. "403587XXXXXX4977". Null when not captured.

piaCaptureDate.description: UTC date/time the charge was captured. Null when not captured.

piaCardType.description: "Visa", "Mastercard", "American Express", or empty. Null when no charge.

deliveryAgentId.description:
Currently assigned delivery agent enum value.
PharmacyDriver=1, Kings=2, AusPost=4. Null when not yet assigned.

deliveryCompleted.description: True when the delivery has been marked as completed (FR20).

availableDeliveryAgents.description: Delivery agents available for this pharmacy (FR19).

totalPrice.description:
Sum of every component price including the Delivery-Cost line — this matches
the MVC PendingOrder.cshtml displayed total (NFR-F1 fidelity).
Required by Story 4.2 — pricing must not require a separate API call.

totalGst.description: Sum of every component's GST including the Delivery-Cost line (see TotalPrice).

isDeleted.description:
True when the order was soft-deleted (dismissed by the pharmacist).
Only meaningful in the completed order context — pending orders are never deleted.
When true the completed order dialog shows a "Dismissed" banner and hides action buttons.

MedAdvisor.PharmacyUnifiedAPI.v1.Models..description: A shipping agent option shown in the delivery section dropdown (Story 4.1 — FR19).

value.description: Integer value of the DeliveryAgent enum (PharmacyDriver=1, Kings=2, AusPost=4).

MedAdvisor.PharmacyUnifiedAPI.v1.Models..description:
A single line item within a pending order, with its status pre-resolved server-side.
Used by the Angular Pending Order dialog (RAP-6 — Epic 2, Story 2.1).

drugLabelName.description:
Full display name: brand name + form + strength
(DrugLabelNameWithStrengthForm from RefillOrderComponentPending).
Shown as the primary label for OTC items; secondary label for non-OTC (Story 3.4).

drugActiveName.description:
Active ingredient name (e.g. "Amoxicillin").
Shown as the primary (bold) label for non-OTC prescription items (Story 3.4, NFR-F1).
Null / empty for OTC items.

repeatsRemaining.description:
Remaining repeats on the script.
-1 means unknown (no previous dispense found or deferred script).

lastDispenseDate.description:
Date of the most recent dispense.
Null when RepeatsRemaining is -1 (deferred / no prior dispense).

status.description:
Pre-resolved line item status.
Mapped from ComponentStatus + ComponentOnOrderStatus + ComponentDeliveryStatus.
DUAL MAINTENANCE: mirrors ModelsMapper.Partial.cs:ToPatientRequestStatusModel().

careePatientId.description:
Patient ID of the caree when this line item was added by a carer on behalf of
someone else. Null when the line item belongs to the order owner.
Required by Story 5.3 for the "For:" navigation link.

careeName.description: Display name of the caree patient. Null when CareePatientId is null.

isCustomItem.description: Custom line item added by a pharmacist (FR13/FR14).

quantityOrdered.description: Number of units ordered. Shown as "Quantity ordered: N" for OTC items (FR11/FR12).

schedule.description: Drug schedule (e.g. "S3", "S8"). An "S3" value shows the S3 badge on OTC items.

ndssCode.description: NDSS code shown in blue beneath the drug name when IsNdss is true (FR10).

userNdss.description: Patient's NDSS number shown in red when IsNdss is true (FR10).

packetSize.description:
Packet size in units for Structured OTC items (FR12).
Used when PacketSizeSupplemental is null/empty.

packetSizeSupplemental.description: Supplemental packet size descriptor (overrides PacketSize when non-empty).

drugSystemCode.description:
Internal drug system code.
Callers can test for RefillOrderComponentPending.RefillOrderDeliveryCostSystemCode
to identify the delivery cost line.

hasEScript.description: True when this line item has at least one associated eScript token.

eScriptTokens.description:
eScript tokens associated with this line item, sorted by prescription date descending
(matches MVC PendingOrder.cshtml ordering). Empty list when HasEScript is false.

MedAdvisor.PharmacyUnifiedAPI.v1.Models..description:
Summary of a single eScript token embedded in the pending order line item response (FR4).
Provides enough information to display the token list without a separate detail round-trip.
Full detail is returned by GET /RefillOrder/EScriptToken/{orderId}/{tokenId} (FR15).

token.description: The token identifier string — used as the key for GET /EScriptToken.

repeatsRemainingDisplay.description:
EScriptDto.RepeatsRemaining + 1, matching the MVC PendingOrder.cshtml display
(the raw BLL value is one less than the pharmacist-visible count).

isExpired.description:
True when PrescriptionDate + 12 months < today.
Note: S8 drugs expire after 6 months in the MVC — deferred to Story 5.4 walkthrough
because RefillOrderComponentPending.Schedule is not currently surfaced here.

isSelected.description: True when this token is the currently selected EScriptInComponent for the line item.

MedAdvisor.PharmacyUnifiedAPI.v1.Models..description:
Full eScript token detail returned by GET /RefillOrder/EScriptToken/{orderId}/{tokenId} (FR15).
Maps from EScriptDto in MedAdvisor.Framework.Interface.

qrCodeForToken.description:
Base64-encoded PNG of the token QR code, or null if unavailable.
Render as: <img src="data:image/png;base64,{QrCodeForToken}">

MedAdvisor.PharmacyUnifiedAPI.v1.Models..description:
Request body for PUT /RefillOrder/Delivery/{orderId} (Story 4.1 — FR18, FR19, FR20).
All fields are optional — only non-null values are applied.

deliveryAgent.description:
Delivery agent integer value (FR19).
PharmacyDriver=1, Kings=2, AusPost=4.

markAsCompleted.description:
When true, marks the delivery as completed (FR20).
When false, clears the completed date.
Null leaves the current status unchanged.

MedAdvisor.PharmacyUnifiedAPI.v1.Models..description: Request body for POST /RefillOrder/AddNote (Epic 5 — Story 5.1, FR24).

note.description: Note text. Pass null or empty string to clear the existing note. Max 250 chars.

MedAdvisor.PharmacyUnifiedAPI.v1.Models..description: Request body for POST /RefillOrder/Complete (RAP-6 — Story 2.5b FR27, Story 4.3 FR22).

message.description:
Patient-facing notification message (maps to the "omessage:" BLL parameter).
Pre-filled with a context-aware default on the Angular side; editable before submission.

chargeCard.description:
True to charge the patient's saved card (PIA orders only).
False = finalise without charging (maps to DeclinePayment intent on the order).
Ignored for non-PIA orders.

lineItemPrices.description: Per-line-item prices entered by the pharmacist. PIA orders only; null/empty for others.

MedAdvisor.PharmacyUnifiedAPI.v1.Models..description: Per-component price entered by the pharmacist at PIA order completion.

price.description:
Total price entered by the pharmacist. When GstApplies=true this is the GST-inclusive
amount; GST = Round(Price/11, 2), Net = Price - GST. Matches MVC behaviour.

gstApplies.description: True when the item is subject to GST.

MedAdvisor.PharmacyUnifiedAPI.v1.Models..description: Request body for POST /RefillOrder/SendEScript (RAP-6 — Story 3.3, FR16).

Response from POST /RefillOrder/SendEScript (RAP-6 — Story 3.3, FR16).
            
Always returned as HTTP 200 so Angular can distinguish the three outcomes without
intercepting HTTP errors:
  SUCCESS            — token sent to MedView Flow successfully.
  FALLBACK_TO_PLUSONE — pharmacy has no MedView Flow ID; Angular must call the
                       PlusOne JS bridge (uicontroller.SendEScriptTokenToDispense).
  ERROR              — MedView Flow returned an error; Message contains detail.
Request body for POST /RefillOrder/LineItem/{orderId} (RAP-6 — Story 3.5, FR13).

name.description: Custom item display name (max 50 chars, matching MVC input maxlength).

quantity.description: Quantity to dispense. Defaults to 1 when absent or zero.

MedAdvisor.PharmacyUnifiedAPI.v1.Models..description:
Request body for POST /RefillOrder/UpdateLineItemStatus (RAP-6 — Story 3.1).
Carries the orderId + componentId so the service can verify component ownership
before delegating to the BLL.

followUpDate.description:
Required when {MedAdvisor.PharmacyUnifiedAPI.v1.Models.UpdateLineItemStatusRequest.Action} is {MedAdvisor.PharmacyUnifiedAPI.v1.Enums.UpdateLineItemAction.OnOrder}.
Stored as the estimated stock availability date ("cdatefollowup" BLL parameter).

MedAdvisor.PharmacyUnifiedAPI.v1.Models..description: Request body for POST /api/v1/RefillOrder/CompletedOrder/{orderId}/Reminder (Epic 6 — Story 6.2).

Bearer.description: JWT Authorization header using the Bearer scheme. Example: "Authorization: Bearer {token}"
Bearer.name: Authorization
